service_types.label: Aerial Photography
service_types.description: RGB imagery from drone-mounted cameras. Deliverables: JPEG/TIFF photos, geo-tagged, may include orthoimage mosaic.

service_types.label: LiDAR Scanning
service_types.description: 3D point cloud capture using laser ranging. Deliverables: LAZ/LAS point cloud, DEM, DSM, contours.

service_types.label: Multispectral Imaging
service_types.description: Near-IR and visible band imagery for vegetation and crop health analysis. Deliverables: band-separated TIFF, NDVI maps.

service_types.label: Thermal Imaging
service_types.description: Infrared thermography for heat detection. Deliverables: thermal TIFF, false-colour overlays.

service_types.label: Photogrammetry
service_types.description: Structure-from-motion processing of overlapping imagery into 3D models. Deliverables: point cloud, mesh, textured model, orthoimage.

service_types.label: 3D Modeling
service_types.description: Processed photogrammetry or LiDAR delivered as CAD-ready or game-engine-ready 3D model.

service_types.label: Inspection
service_types.description: Close-range visual or sensor inspection of structures, assets, or infrastructure.

service_types.label: Construction Progress Documentation
service_types.description: Recurring photogrammetry or RGB flights tied to construction milestones. Deliverables: orthoimage series, delta overlays, progress reports.

service_types.label: Mapping
service_types.description: Planimetric or topographic map production from drone data. Deliverables: georeferenced raster, vector layers, contour lines.

service_types.label: Surveillance
service_types.description: Persistent or repeated monitoring of a site or asset over time.

certifications.name: FAA Part 107
certifications.description: US remote pilot certificate required for commercial drone operations.

certifications.name: Transport Canada RPAS Basic
certifications.description: Basic RPAS pilot certificate for commercial drone operations in Canada.

certifications.name: Transport Canada RPAS Advanced
certifications.description: Advanced RPAS certificate allowing operations in controlled airspace.

certifications.name: EASA A2 Certificate of Competency
certifications.description: European A2 CofC for operations close to uninvolved persons.

certifications.name: General Liability Insurance
certifications.description: Commercial general liability insurance; minimum $1M per occurrence typical.
